$comment: Config-as-code SigNoz alert rules for finance_report (#373/#1106/#906). The app references FinanceReportBackendErrorLogs in apps/backend/src/observability.py; this file is the reviewable source of truth. Applied idempotently by `invoke fr-observability.shared.apply-alerts`, which routes rules to the shared Feishu/Lark bridge channel. The SigNoz v5 payloads are derived from this shape by libs/observability_dashboards.py + libs/alerting.py. PromQL must select OTel metrics by their dotted names in the quoted form ({"metric.name","label.key"="v"}) because SigNoz runs with DOT_METRICS_ENABLED; per-rule thresholds, windows and absence choices are explained in docs/ssot/ops.observability.md SOP-004C.
